author: Mark Atwood
text: Maintainer risk: MEDIUM — two P0 correctness bugs in the /set path are wire-reachable (unknown-accountId silently mutates the backend and auto-creates phantom accounts); five P1 findings cover spec contract gaps (invalidProperties shape, per-user uniqueness scoping) and untested method coverage (/query, /queryChanges). The crate's foundation pattern (cookie-cutter from canonical mail-server) is sound, but the /set path diverged from the canonical at the account_exists check and the SetError construction style — both are propagation regressions, not novel bugs. The MemoryBackend reference impl is honestly demo-grade for /set + /changes but silently misleading for /query (filter/sort ignored).
